scenes.text: This tutorial covers Train Cellpose. Train a custom Cellpose or CPSAM-compatible segmentation model from curated image-mask pairs.
Open Train Cellpose from the Segmentation models section. Provide diverse training and validation images with carefully corrected label masks.
In the main configuration area, choose channels, base model, diameter, augmentation, learning rate, epochs, batch size, and validation split.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. monitor training and validation losses and test checkpoints on fields that were not used for training.
When the workflow finishes, the selected checkpoint, training history, validation predictions, and settings are stored together.
